issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in assessing credibility of the marriage, polygamy and children evidence
issues.applicant_position: RPD misread evidence; inaccuracies in certificates are due to husband's and authorities' errors.
issues.result_text: RPD's decision is wrong; it is set aside for reasons to follow.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD applied Guideline 4 on women claimants fearing gender-related persecution
issues.applicant_position: RPD did not properly consider Guideline 4; she was subservient and followed husband's orders.
issues.result_text: Guideline 4 applies to her forced polygamous marriage and abuse, and was considered in the analysis.

issues.issue: Whether the polygamous marriage to XXXX is established
issues.applicant_position: Certificate contradictions were the husband's errors; deceased father witness is an uncle with same name.
issues.result_text: Points do not show the court's own finding on the marriage; reasons to follow.
